correctness.rationale: From the 2n-element monomial basis, the characteristic-two square of h(y)+xj(y) equals h(y)^2, forcing ord h>=ceil(n/2). For n odd Y^n=0 forces g(0)=0 because f1!=0; for n even there is no condition. The invertible cotangent matrix is triangular with diagonal j0,f1. Counting parameters gives d_n=3n-4+floor(n/2)+1_even; derivation constraints give 4n-2_odd. The reduced-group dimension is d_n+2, so the difference is floor(n/2)+1. Exhaustive independent finite checks: F2 n3=64,n4=2048; F4 n3=36864; F2 derivations n3=1024,n4=65536. Finite checks support but do not replace the all-field proof.

value.rationale: The natural height-asymmetric two-generator Artin complete intersections have unknown from the compared literature their full ungraded characteristic-two automorphism normal forms and finite-field group orders. The exact unbounded gap floor(n/2)+1 between infinitesimal derivations and reduced symmetry dimensions quantifies inseparability of automorphism group schemes, intrinsically and uniformly across all n>=3, rather than recording an isolated numerical calculation; it motivates deformation and orbit-stabilizer analysis. Excludes the trivial n=2 boundary and does not assert a general scheme decomposition.
